Because Grace at the botanical garden **tells the truth**, anyone who says “the botanical garden lies” must be lying. The **gym** says that, so the gym **lies**. The **hotel** says “the gym tells the truth,” which is false, so the hotel **lies**. The **observatory** says “the hotel tells the truth,” which is also false, so the observatory **lies**.

**no, no, no**
